about:
LEA Reviewer started from my own struggles while preparing for the Architecture Licensure Examination.

I found myself jumping between reviewers, PDFs, notes, lectures, and countless references. There was so much information to study, but not always an easy or organized way to understand and remember it.

So I started building the kind of reviewer I wished I had—something more organized, visual, interactive, and focused on actually understanding concepts instead of simply memorizing them.

LEA Reviewer is still growing alongside my own journey. Every difficult topic, mistake, and challenge I encounter becomes another reason to improve it.

What started as a tool to help myself has become something I hope can also make the journey a little easier for other future architects.
 
EME!
support_note:
LEA Reviewer is something I’ve been building on my own while reviewing for the boards too.

If it has helped you and you’d like to chip in, even a small amount helps me keep improving the site and adding more review materials.
